name: Lantern market night
one_line: Strings of orange lanterns over dark water at dusk.
look_words: A floating market on a warm evening. The sky and water are deep dusk blue and violet; boats, stalls and boardwalks are dark wood in plum, red and teal. Strings of round orange paper lanterns hang everywhere, and their light ripples on the water and warms every face and plank near them. It is busy but gentle: steam from cooking pots, striped awnings, people chatting. Lantern orange marks places to visit and things to collect, jade marks the goal, pink-red is harm, and the player is pale cream. Shapes are soft and painted with a clean outline. Motion is lively: lanterns swaying, steam rising, reflections breaking up, boats nudging each other. Avoid cold white light, neon colours, empty streets and bloom that blurs the lanterns.

palette.name: lantern dusk
palette.notes: The main light is warm lantern light against cool violet air: that contrast is the whole look. Add small warm lights at the lanterns you place.

look_wish: soft painted shading with clean outlines, or none

upgrade.why: real little flames for stoves and lanterns
water that carries the lantern reflections and ripples when touched

music.mood: warm plucked strings, hand percussion and a soft flute

sound_feel: sizzling, chatter, water lapping, wooden creaks, a small bell
